name: Bharat Forge Ltd
about: Bharat Forge is engaged in the manufacturing and selling of forged and machined components for the auto and industrial sectors.[1]
keyPoints: Part of Kalyani Group [1] [2] The company is the flagship entity of Pune-based Kalyani Group, a diversified Indian multinational with interests in forging, auto components, engineering steel, infrastructure, renewable energy, and specialty chemicals. The group has a global manufacturing footprint across India, Germany, Sweden, and China, with over US$3 Bn in annual turnover and a workforce of 10,000+ employees.
pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 38.6% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 41.6%
cons: Stock is trading at 7.37 times its book value
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -0.95%
Company has a low return on equity of 12.2% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost

announcements.text: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Acquisition 18 Nov - Bharat Forge invested Rs 290.5 crore in KSSL via rights issue on November 18, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Scheme of Arrangement 17 Nov - FTSPL merged into BF Infrastructure effective November 17, 2026; FTSPL dissolved, shareholding unchanged.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release 16 Nov - Amit Shah visited Pune facility, inaugurated 60th anniversary plaque, and flagged off rifles consignment for UPSTF.
Intimation Regarding Approval Of Resolution Plan For Tork Motors Private Limited 12 Nov - NCLT approved Tork Motors’ resolution plan on November 6, 2026; it will cease as a subsidiary.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release (Revised) 12 Nov - KSSL advanced development of its 120mm vehicle-mounted R.A.M.S mortar system on November 12, 2026.
